name: banque-papa-maman
description: Banque de papa et maman: a zero-knowledge virtual savings account parents run for their kids.

scripts.dev: vite build && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local && node scripts/dev.mjs
scripts.deploy: vite build && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote && wrangler deploy
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p src/engine/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p worker/tsconfig.json

ADMIN_TOKEN.description: Your admin password: a long random string, 32+ characters. Keep it in your password manager. You paste it on /admin to create your bank and invite friends.

DB.description: Stores encrypted blobs only. Nobody, not even you, can read a family's data from it.
